module web.title_length
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web
import std.http exposing Url

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: Why the length of a page title could not be reported.
  NoTitle(reason: Text)
  Unreachable(detail: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  purpose: Count the characters of the text inside the first title element, ignoring surrounding whitespace, and fail when there is no title or it is empty.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<TITLE>  Renyi docs </TITLE>") is 10

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_at be lowered.index_of("<title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle(reason: "the page has no <title> element")
  let content_start be open_at + 7
  let rest be html.drop(content_start)
  let close_at be rest.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle(reason: "the <title> element is never closed")
  let title be rest.take(close_at).trim()
  if title.is_empty() then
    fail with NoTitle(reason: "the <title> element is empty")
  end
  return title.length()
end

public function page_title_length(url: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with a clear error when the page has no title.
  tags: web, html, agents
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with Unreachable(detail: "the page could not be downloaded")
  return title_length(page) otherwise fail
end

test "a plain title is counted"
  check title_length("<title>Hello</title>") is 5
end

test "case and padding are ignored"
  check title_length("<TITLE>  Renyi docs </TITLE>") is 10
end

module web.page_title
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: The ways measuring a page title can fail.
  BadUrl(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle
end

public function title_length(page: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  purpose: Count the characters between the title tags of an HTML page.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length("<html><title>Hello</title></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<TITLE>Hi</TITLE>") is 2
  example: title_length("<title></title>") is 0

  let lowered be page.to_lower()
  let open_at be lowered.index_of("<title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle
  let remainder be page.drop(open_at + 7)
  let close_at be remainder.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle
  return remainder.take(close_at).length()
end

public function page_title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with NoTitle when the page has none.
  tags: web, html
  expose as tool

  let url be web.Url(address) otherwise fail with BadUrl(address: address)
  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  return title_length(page)
end

test "the title length is counted"
  check title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
end

module page_titles
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http
import std.http exposing Url

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: The ways a title measurement can fail.
  BadAddress(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle(address: Text)
  can ToText
end

function title_text(html: Text)
  returns maybe Text
  purpose: Find the trimmed text inside the first title element, or nothing when it is missing or blank.
  example: title_text("<html><title>Hello</title></html>") is "Hello"
  example: title_text("<TITLE>  Padded  </TITLE>") is "Padded"
  example: title_text("<html><body>No title</body></html>") is nothing
  example: title_text("<title>   </title>") is nothing

  let lower be html.to_lower()
  let start be lower.index_of("<title>") otherwise return nothing
  let after be html.drop(start + 7)
  let after_lower be after.to_lower()
  let stop be after_lower.index_of("</title>") otherwise return nothing
  let title be after.take(stop).trim()
  if title.is_empty() then
    return nothing
  end
  return title
end

public function title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with NoTitle when the page has none.
  tags: web, html, title
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with BadAddress(address: address)
  let page be http.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  let title be title_text(page) otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  return title.length()
end

test "the title text is extracted and trimmed"
  check title_text("<html><title> Hi there </title></html>") is "Hi there"
end

test "a page without a title yields nothing"
  check title_text("<html></html>") is nothing
end

module web.title_length
  purpose: Give agents a tool that measures the title of a web page.

import std.http as web exposing Url

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: The ways that measuring a page title can fail.
  BadAddress(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle(address: Text)
end

public function title_of(html: Text)
  returns maybe Text
  purpose: Find the text inside the first title element of an HTML document, or nothing when there is none or it is blank.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_of("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is "Hello"
  example: title_of("<html><body>No title here</body></html>") is nothing
  example: title_of("<TITLE>Loud</TITLE>") is "Loud"
  example: title_of("<title>   </title>") is nothing

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let start be lowered.index_of("<title>") otherwise return nothing
  let after be html.drop(start + 7)
  let stop be after.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise return nothing
  let title be after.take(stop)
  if title.trim().is_empty() then
    return nothing
  end
  return title
end

public function title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing when the page has no title.
  tags: web, html, agent
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with BadAddress(address: address)
  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  let title be title_of(page) otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  return title.length()
end

test "the title is found"
  check title_of("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is "Hello"
end

test "a page without a title gives nothing"
  check title_of("<html><body>Nothing</body></html>") is nothing
end
